summary: Same setup as GT-BIBLE-PIN-T; conservative entry: limit order at 50% of the pin's range.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: you start by identifying a clear uptrend or downtrend, and you wait for a pin bar to occur after a pullback to support or resistance level.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: The formation of the pin bar indicates the end of the retracement move, and the beginning of the impulsive move

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: bullish pin bars that were formed in line with the uptrend work, and they should be taken into consideration. But the bearish ones that were formed against the trend should be ignored.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: entering the market immediately after the pin bar closes without waiting for a confirmation.

sources.label: SOURCE_CHART
sources.quote: GOLD H4 uptrend: two bullish pins after pullbacks to support with 21 MA and 50% Fibonacci

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: it is characterized by a very long tail that shows rejection

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: typically all pin bars have a very small real body and a long shadow.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: The Hammer candlestick is created when the open high and close are roughly the same price; it is also characterized by a long lower shadow

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Professional technicians say that the shadow should be twice the length of the real body.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: Pin bars with longer tails are more powerful.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: The pin bar formed in line with the direction of the market is more powerful than the one which is formed against the trend.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: If you are in this situation, you can use the 21-moving average which will act as a dynamic support in an uptrend market and a dynamic resistance in a downtrend market.

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: i personally use the 8 and 21 moving average

sources.label: SOURCE_EXPLICIT
sources.quote: I use the 61% and 50 % Fibonacci retracement to find the most powerful areas in the market.

price.BULL: (pin high + pin low) / 2, quantised down to the tick
price.BEAR: (pin high + pin low) / 2, quantised up to the tick
